custom_logic_notes: EA trades once per day only. Determines trend direction over last N hours (configurable input). Enters in OPPOSITE direction of detected trend (counter-trend/mean-reversion strategy). The '10 pips' in the name refers to both SL and TP being 10 pips. Digit adjustment is applied: SL and TP are multiplied by 10 when broker uses 5-digit pricing (_Digits==5 or _Point<0.001). A daily trade flag prevents multiple entries on the same calendar day.
python_conversion_notes: Simple counter-trend EA. Key conversion points: 1) Determine trend over last N hours by comparing current close vs close N hours back (using hourly candles). 2) Once-per-day gate requires tracking last trade date. 3) Fixed 10-pip SL/TP with 5-digit adjustment (multiply by 10). 4) No custom indicators needed - pure price action trend detection. 5) Position check before entry. 6) Suitable for any symbol, any timeframe but H1 is natural fit for hourly trend lookback.
